latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release enabling bidirectional sync between Obsidian notes and a structured ontology.

- Automatically extracts entities and relationships (Person, Organization, Project, etc.) from Obsidian markdown notes.
- Maintains a machine-queryable ontology graph and runs regular analytics to provide insights.
- Generates structured feedback to help improve note structure and templates.
- Configurable via YAML, with automatic sync, analysis, and feedback scheduled via cron.
- Supports actionable queries on synced knowledge (e.g., team assignments, missing data, relationship gaps).
